constraints: Events/hints are not lifecycle, claim, execution or publication authority.
Activation neither selects strategy nor creates obligations.
Hint/timer/cursor state is disposable; canonical work is recovery truth.
Stale hints cannot resurrect non-current work.
FE/BE independence follows semantic dependencies, not stages.
A durable host may run activation but cannot become source of truth or hidden scheduler.
invariants: one domain outage must not block unrelated domain work
queued stale hints cannot resurrect invalidated work
architectureDecisions: Level-triggered per-domain activation; every reconcile rereads canonical work.
Key={projectId,workId,owningDomain}; hint data grants no authority.
Canonical scans recover missed hints; duplicates converge via claim/release + attempt currentness.
BB-052 owns obligation currentness and canonical work invalidation/fencing; BB-053 reads it only.
DomainExecutionInput is immutable/content-addressed and must match WorkContract domain/workload.
DomainExecutionController owns policy/strategy/attempt/runtime binding; activation never selects HOW.
BACKEND/FRONTEND use separate principals, hosts, controllers and adapters; shared stores provide only canonical CAS/currentness.
Post-release exact obligation subject+revision recheck gates execute; drift yields no attempt while BB-052 handles invalidation/fencing.
Parallel proof requires both domains to enter dispatch before either completes; host failure/invalidation stays local.
implementationSlices: D1 — Execution input artifact [AC-5, AC-6]: implement domain-execution-input.js with createDomainExecutionInput(raw), putDomainExecutionInput(raw) and resolveDomainExecutionInput(ref), wired through organization-artifact-store.js/index.js. WorkContract execution requires exactly one requiredArtifactRef resolving to matching owningDomain/workloadType; zero/multiple/mismatch fails pre-dispatch. Verify frontend-domain + fe-be-parallel.

D2 — Controller adapter contract [AC-2, AC-3, AC-4, INV-4]: in domain-execution-control.js define adapter dispatch/recover input {binding,contract,input,runtimeInvocationKey}; contract is the exact released-claim WorkContract. Controller alone resolves current policy/strategy, binds attempt, revalidates release and attests runtime. Activation cannot supply HOW. Verify domain-activation + bb048 regression.

D3A — Canonical activation/recovery [AC-1, AC-2, AC-7, INV-1, INV-2, INV-3]: add domain-activation-source.js/domain-activation.js. scan({owningDomain}) delegates to listEligible({owningDomain}); reconcile({projectId,workId,owningDomain}) rereads canonical WorkContract before claim. Notify carries only that exact key; lost hints recover by scan; duplicate scan/notify converges via existing claim/release + attempt currentness. Verify domain-activation + activation-recovery.

D3B — Domain/authority admission [AC-3, INV-1, INV-3, INV-4, INV-5]: before claim require configured host domain === key domain === WorkContract.owningDomain. Principal comes from host configuration, obligation provenance from WorkContract, policy/strategy/runtime from DomainExecutionController; hint fields cannot override them. Mismatch => NOOP/REJECTED with claim=0, attempt=0, dispatch=0. Verify domain-activation + bb047 regression.

D3C — BB-052 currentness adapter [AC-4, AC-8, INV-8]: in domain-activation-source.js define createObligationCurrentnessReader({resolveObligation,currentHead}) exposing current(obligationRef)->{subjectKey,revision,status}; this adapter is read-only and binds the exact WorkContract-required CrossDomainObligation revision to BB-052 currentness after the BB-052 TASK_OUTPUT dependency is satisfied. domain-activation observes ACTIVE before claim, releases canonically, rereads the same subject immediately before execute, and returns NOOP before DomainExecutionController.execute on revision/status drift. BB-052 alone owns canonical invalidation/release fencing; unrelated current obligations remain scan-eligible. Verify partial-invalidation + activation-recovery.

D4 — Backend execution adapter [AC-5, AC-6]: add createBackendExecutionStrategy(...) in backend-execution-strategy.js. Resolve exact DomainExecutionInput, map WorkContract+input to BackendObjective, dispatch via prepareBackendObjective + runPreparedBackendObjective, recover via recoverPreparedBackendObjective, and map APPLIED/BLOCKED/FAILED plus output/evidence refs to DomainExecutionController. Never call the Backend→QA composite flow. Verify fe-be-parallel + bb048 regression.

D5 — Frontend execution domain [AC-5, AC-6, INV-6, INV-7]: add frontend-contracts/completion/worker/application/execution-strategy modules. Frontend application exposes prepareFrontendObjective, runPreparedFrontendObjective and recoverPreparedFrontendObjective; completion requires frontend.mutation, frontend.typecheck and frontend.tests evidence. createFrontendExecutionStrategy(...) consumes only exact Frontend WorkContract+DomainExecutionInput and has no Backend stage/session/completion dependency. Verify frontend-domain + fe-be-parallel.

D6A — DomainActivationHost [AC-1, AC-2, AC-7, INV-2, INV-3]: add createDomainActivationHost({owningDomain,discovery,activation,scanIntervalMs,timer}) -> {start,scanOnce,notify,stop}. start is idempotent and runs immediate then periodic scans; scanOnce does listEligible(domain) then Promise.allSettled(reconcile(exactKey)); notify accepts same-domain exact-key hint only; stop cancels/drains only that host. No priority/nextRole/nextDomain/stage API. Verify domain-host-autonomy + activation-recovery.

D6B — Independent FE/BE composition [AC-5, AC-6, INV-6, INV-7]: add createFrontendBackendDomainRuntime({backendHost,frontendHost})->{startAll,stopAll}; both use Promise.allSettled over separate hosts/controllers/policy subjects/prebound adapters/currentness ports and no shared queue, lock, strategy switch or ordered dispatcher. fe-be-parallel uses distinct BACKEND/FRONTEND contracts, inputs, policies, strategies and barriers proving both dispatchStarted before either completes; reject one adapter after both starts and prove sibling reaches terminal. Verify fe-be-parallel + domain-host-autonomy.

D7 — Acceptance proof matrix [AC-1..AC-8, INV-1..INV-8]: add domain-activation, activation-recovery, domain-host-autonomy, frontend-domain, fe-be-parallel and partial-invalidation tests exposing claimCalls, attemptCount, dispatchCount, dispatchStarted barriers and exact identity refs. Run bb047/bb048 regressions + npm run test:agentic; no criterion relies on narrative-only evidence.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Persisted actionable work is rediscovered and processed after controller restart even when its original notification was lost.
evidenceRequired: fresh host/no hints -> immediate scan -> claim/execute

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Concurrent duplicate hints for one work item converge to one current claim/execution path.
evidenceRequired: concurrent scan+notify -> one current claim/attempt; duplicate NOOP/replay

acceptanceCriteria.statement: A wrong-domain activation attempt cannot claim or execute the work.
evidenceRequired: wrong host/key/contract domain -> claim=0, attempt=0, dispatch=0

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Obligation supersession between activation pre-check and execution entry prevents execution through the post-release currentness recheck.
evidenceRequired: pause after release; supersede same subject; recheck fences; attempt=dispatch=0; sibling executes

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Frontend and Backend work can progress concurrently and independently under their own domain execution strategies.
evidenceRequired: distinct FE/BE contracts+policies+adapters; both dispatchStarted before either completes; identities differ

acceptanceCriteria.statement: An outage in one domain leaves unrelated work in another domain actionable and able to progress.
evidenceRequired: after both dispatchStarted, fail one adapter; sibling still reaches terminal without failed-domain state

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Removing a manual next-role dispatcher does not stop progress for persisted actionable work.
evidenceRequired: no nextRole/nextDomain/stage API; startup/periodic scans progress persisted work without event

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Partial upstream invalidation suppresses only affected activation subjects while unrelated domain work remains actionable.
evidenceRequired: invalidate only A; stale A NOOP/fenced; next scan executes unrelated B

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Wake-up event or hint data cannot grant principal, claim, execution, strategy, obligation or publication authority.
evidenceRequired: spoofed hint authority fields cannot alter principal/claim/attempt/publication

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Queue, cursor, timer and hint state are disposable latency state and never canonical work truth.
evidenceRequired: delete hint/timer state; restart scan rediscovers same work

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Activation operates on exact work identities and cannot rank, schedule or choose a next role/domain.
evidenceRequired: activation exposes exact-key reconcile/domain scan only; no ranking/next-role/stage API

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Activation cannot select or override ExecutionPolicy, ExecutionStrategyDescriptor or runtime adapter.
evidenceRequired: activation passes only released-claim identity; controller still resolves policy/strategy/adapter

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Activation cannot create, mutate or make current a CrossDomainObligation.
evidenceRequired: activation has no obligation-write capability; forged obligation hint data is inert

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Frontend and Backend have no implicit stage barrier; only explicit semantic work dependencies may block actionability.
evidenceRequired: unrelated FE/BE both dispatch before completion; Frontend reads no Backend stage/session state

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Failure of one owning-domain host cannot cancel, gate or pause unrelated domain progress.
evidenceRequired: one adapter failure stays host-local; sibling reaches terminal

acceptanceCriteria.statement: A stale hint cannot resurrect work whose exact obligation/currentness became non-current.
evidenceRequired: non-current exact subject + stale hint -> no new claim/attempt/dispatch; unrelated work remains executable

negativeVerificationCases: Hint authority/domain/strategy/obligation spoofing fails before side effects.
Lost/duplicate hints recover/converge without duplicate current claim/attempt.
Missing/multiple/mismatched DomainExecutionInput or adapter mismatch fails before dispatch.
Post-release obligation drift fences exact claim; sibling remains executable.
FE/BE proof requires overlapping dispatch; one host failure cannot block sibling.
